result.prior_version_note: For eviction notices served 3/1/2025–2/28/2026, the San Francisco Rent Board listed $436.00/day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses. The current rate is $446.00/day for notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027. The documents do not say when Civ. Code § 1947.9 itself first took effect.
